0.name: Hero
0.title: Hero
0.description: A hero is a unit that allows you to play cards of its color in its lane. A hero can equip items. When it is killed, it is worth 5 Bounty to the opponent and returns to the Fountain to be redeployed later.

1.name: Creep
1.title: Creep
1.description: A creep is a non-hero unit. Unlike a hero, a creep cannot equip items, and does not return to play after it is killed. It is worth 1 Bounty to the opponent when killed.

2.name: Tower
2.title: Tower
2.description: Each lane contains an allied tower that must be defended and an enemy tower that must be destroyed. The objective of the game is to destroy any 2 enemy towers. The tower can be a target of some spells and abilities.

3.name: Enchantment
3.title: Enchantment
3.description: A permanent effect that attaches to a tower, caster, or unit. Can be dispelled by another effect.

4.name: Spell
4.title: Spell
4.description: A spell (▪) is a card that has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game. Spells deal damage, modify objects in play temporarily or permanently, summon units, or draw cards.

5.name: Item
5.title: Item
5.description: An item is a card that can be purchased during the shopping phase using gold. A Weapon, Armor, or Accessory item is equipped onto a hero to buff its stats. A consumable item has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game.

300.name: Fountain
300.title: Fountain
300.description: When heroes die they are placed in the Fountain zone for a full round before becoming ready to redeploy. When heroes enter the Fountain they are fully healed and temporary effects on them are purged.

400.name: Battles
400.title: Battle
400.description: When units battle, they strike each other, dealing their Attack Attack as physical damage.

401.name: Modify
401.title: Modify
401.description: When an effect modifies another card it applies a permanent buff or debuff to the target. Heroes retain modifiers through death.

402.name: Purge
402.title: Purge
402.description: Removes modifications and temporary effects, but not damage. Purging does not affect base abilities or external effects, such as those from equipped items and continuous effects from auras.

403.name: Taunts
403.title: Taunt
403.description: When a unit taunts all of its adjacent enemies change their combat target to that unit. Targets reset after each round.

405.name: Stun
405.title: Stun
405.description: Stunned units cannot be casters and cannot use their active abilities or active abilities of their items. Stunned units cannot strike.

406.name: Silence
406.title: Silence
406.description: Silenced units cannot be casters and cannot use their active abilities or active abilities of their items.

407.name: Lock
407.title: Lock
407.description: A delay that prevents the card from being played for that many rounds. Lock decreases at the end of the round.

409.name: Summon
409.title: Summon
409.description: Creates a unit and puts it directly into play.

410.name: Bounce
410.title: Bounce
410.description: Return to hand (if creep) or the fountain (if hero) unless rooted.

412.name: Slay
412.title: Slay
412.description: Kill a unit. Death Shields may save it, but Damage Immunity does not.

414.name: Push
414.title: Push
414.description: Move a unit 1 slot randomly left or right to an unoccupied spot.

415.name: Hex
415.title: Hex
415.description: Transform a unit into a harmless form that can perform no actions.

416.name: Jump
416.title: Jump
416.description: Select a new target for this effect.

417.name: Give
417.title: Give
417.description: Give a unit an effect that lasts for one round unless otherwise specified.

418.name: Swap
418.title: Swap
418.description: Move to the targeted slot. If occoupied, switch positions with that unit.

421.name: Root
421.title: Root
421.description: Prevent a unit from moving or being bounced. Lasts until the end of round by default.

422.name: Clone
422.title: Clone
422.description: Summon a copy of this unit.

423.name: Strikes
423.title: Strike
423.description: When a unit strikes another unit, it deals its Attack Attack to that unit as physical damage, unless a different amount is specified. Disarmed units and stunned units cannot strike.

424.name: Enfeeble
424.title: Enfeeble
424.description: Excess Attack Attack damage to this unit is dealt to its owner's tower in the combat phase.

500.name: Bounty
500.title: Bounty
500.description: The amount of gold awarded to the opponent when this unit dies.

501.name: Siege
501.title: Siege
501.description: During the combat phase, deal Siege damage to the enemy tower as physical damage.

502.name: Cleave
502.title: Cleave
502.description: Cleave damage is dealt to all adjacent enemies in the combat phase as physical damage. Doesn't hit towers.

503.name: Retaliate
503.title: Retaliate
503.description: When a unit strikes another unit with Retaliate, the striking unit takes Retaliate damage as physical damage.

504.name: Armor
504.title: Armor ▤
504.description: Armor Armor absorbs this much incoming damage each round. If negative, amplify the first source of incoming damage by this amount.

505.name: Regeneration
505.title: Regeneration
505.description: The unit heals this amount during the combat phase. Regeneration is applied before checking for death.

506.name: Death Shield
506.title: Death Shield
506.description: If a unit would die, instead remove its death shield and it survives with 1 Health Health. A unit may only have one death shield at a time.

508.name: Untargetable
508.title: Untargetable
508.description: Cannot be chosen as a target by the opponent.

509.name: Piercing
509.title: Piercing
509.description: Piercing damage is not reduced by the target's Armor Armor.

510.name: Attack
510.title: Attack ▣
510.description: Units deal their Attack Attack damage when they strike.

511.name: Health
511.title: Health ▥
511.description: The amount of damage a unit can sustain before dying. Damage persists across rounds.

512.name: Max Mana
512.title: Max Mana
512.description: Increasing max mana adds full mana gems. Decreasing max mana removes empty gems first.

513.name: Mana
513.title: Mana
513.description: Current mana. Resource required to cast spells, play items, and activate abilities.

515.name: Rooted
515.title: Rooted
515.description: Cannot be moved or bounced. Movement spells and abilities cannot be played on rooted units unless they have additional effects.

516.name: Devour
516.title: Devour
516.description: When this unit is placed on top of another unit, it gains that unit's Attack Attack and Health Health.

517.name: Lifesteal
517.title: Lifesteal
517.description: This unit heals equal to its Attack Attack if it survives a combat in which it damaged another unit.

518.name: Trample
518.title: Trample
518.description: Excess Attack Attack damage by this unit is dealt to the enemy tower in the combat phase.

519.name: Mulch
519.title: Mulch
519.description: When played, draw a card from your deck that costs less than this one.

520.name: Feeble
520.title: Feeble
520.description: Excess Attack Attack damage to this unit is dealt to your tower in the combat phase.

521.name: Pillager
521.title: Pillager
521.description: This unit steals 2 gold from the opponent whenever it damages their tower.

522.name: Quickstrike
522.title: Quickstrike
522.description: During a battle, units with quickstrike will strike first. Units that die from this damage do not strike.

523.name: Blocker
523.title: Blocker
523.description: Cannot move, strike, be damaged, or targeted by spells or abilities.

524.name: Tracked
524.title: Tracked
524.description: This unit has been tracked by Bounty Hunter, has additional bounty, and takes additional damage when attacked by him.

525.name: Stunned
525.title: Stunned
525.description: Cannot be a caster and cannot use active abilities or active abilities of items. Cannot strike. When attacked, it still deals retaliate damage.

526.name: Silenced
526.title: Silenced
526.description: Cannot be a caster and cannot use active abilities or active abilities of items.

528.name: Reflect
528.title: Reflect
528.description: When targeted or struck, non-reflected damage that would be done to this unit is instead dealt to the caster or striker.

529.name: Lethal to Heroes
529.title: Lethal to Heroes
529.description: Slay each hero this unit deals physical damage to.

532.name: Repeated
532.title: Repeated
532.description: Cast previously. Abilities with triggers ignore Repeated cards.

600.name: Adjacent enemies
600.title: Adjacent Enemies
600.description: Any enemy in the slot across from this unit, or neighboring that slot.

601.name: Neighbors
601.title: Neighbors
601.description: The allied units directly to the left and right of a unit.

602.name: Play Effect
602.title: Play Effect
602.description: An additional effect that is processed at the time you play this card.

604.name: Quickcast
604.title: ▢ Quickcast
604.description: Take another action when you play this. If you use this action to pass, you retain initiative to act first next round.

606.name: Unblocked
606.title: Unblocked
606.description: A unit is unblocked if its combat target is the tower.

607.name: Blocked
607.title: Blocked
607.description: A unit is blocked if it has an enemy unit as their combat target, not a tower.

608.name: Unit
608.title: Unit
608.description: A unit is any creep or hero in a combat position. Towers are not units.

610.name: Physical damage
610.title: Physical Damage
610.description: Attack Attack, Cleave, Siege, and Retaliate are physical damage.

612.name: Pierce
612.title: Pierce
612.description: Damage from a unit with Pierce is not reduced by the target's armor.

615.name: Aura
615.title: Aura
615.description: Applies to units as long as they are within a given area.

616.name: Round Start
616.title: Round Start
616.description: Triggers every round after the Deployment Phase and before the Action Phase.

617.name: After Combat
617.title: After Combat
617.description: Triggers every round after the Combat Phase.

619.name: Minion
619.title: Minion
619.description: An effect which applies to this unit when adjacent to an allied hero.

620.name: Decay
620.title: Decay
620.description: This unit will take extra damage in combat. Ignores Armor Armor entirely.

621.name: Ephemeral
621.title: Ephemeral
621.description: Ephemeral cards disappear from your hand at the end of the round.

623.name: Repeatable
623.title: Repeatable
623.description: Repeatable cards may be cast multiple times in one round. Abilities with triggers ignore Repeated cards.

624.name: Cross Lane
624.title: Cross Lane
624.description: Can affect a lane other than the caster's.

625.name: Cursed
625.title: Cursed
625.description: Destroyed when replaced by another item.

627.name: Passed
627.title: Passed
627.description: Any unit at the starting slot, the ending slot, and all slots in between.

628.name: Unopposed

628.description: A unit is unopposed if there is no enemy unit directly across from it.

Improvement.description: A Tower Enchantment (▩) is a spell that adds a permanent effect to a tower or lane. Tower Enchantments are not units and do not occupy combat positions.

Spell.title: Spell
Spell.description: A spell (▪) is a card that has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game. Spells deal damage, modify objects in play temporarily or permanently, summon units, or draw cards.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: An item is a card that can be purchased during the shopping phase using gold. A Weapon, Armor, or Accessory item is equipped onto a hero to buff its stats. A consumable item has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game.

WeaponItem.title: Weapon Item
WeaponItem.description: A type of item that is equipped in a hero's weapon slot. All weapons increase a hero's Attack Attack.

ArmorItem.title: Armor Item
ArmorItem.description: A type of item that is equipped in a hero's armor slot. All armors increase a hero's Armor Armor.

AccessoryItem.title: Accessory Item
AccessoryItem.description: A type of item that is equipped in a hero's accessory slot. All accessories increase a hero's Health Health.

ConsumableItem.title: Consumable
ConsumableItem.description: A type of item that is not equipped and is played during the action phase like a spell. Consumables may be played without a hero in the lane.

CombatPhase.title: Lane Phases
CombatPhase.description:
There are four phases.

Before the action phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.
Action phase: Players alternate playing cards or abilities.
Combat phase: Each unit strikes its combat target simultaneously.
After the combat phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.

ActionPhase.title: Lane Phases
ActionPhase.description:

Before the action phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.

Combat phase: Each unit strikes its combat target simultaneously.
After the combat phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.

DeploymentPhase.title: Round Phases
DeploymentPhase.description:
There are two phases in between rounds. These phases are played by both players simultaneously.

Shopping phase: Players purchase cards from the item shops using gold.
Deployment phase: Lane creeps are revealed and players choose which lanes to deploy their ready heroes into.

A hero is a unit that allows you to play cards of its color in its lane. A hero can equip items. When it is killed, it is worth 5 Bounty to the opponent and returns to the Fountain to be redeployed later.

A creep is a non-hero unit. Unlike a hero, a creep cannot equip items, and does not return to play after it is killed. It is worth 1 Bounty to the opponent when killed. When played, a creep card puts a unit into an empty combat position of your choice.
A spell is a card that has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game. Spells deal damage, modify objects in play temporarily or permanently, summon units, or draw cards.
Silenced units can't be casters and can't use their active abilities or active abilities of their items.
Kill a unit. Death Shields may save it, but Damage Immunity does not.
Mana is a resource used to play cards and activate abilities. Each round the amount is increased by 1 and refreshed.
